source.note: Cases were selected from chapters with substantial documented expansion needs. This is a retrospective single-book check, not a benchmark.

method.principle: A case is BLOCK only where the historical scene card itself leaves a plot/research/consequence fact materially unresolved under the v0.1 gate. HUMAN_REVIEW is used where completeness exists but experiential adequacy remains judgmental. PASS_FALSE_NEGATIVE is retained when the new gate would likely have let an expansion-heavy scene through.

cases.basis: The scene card still places the work in a later-to-be-researched BKA/police setting; the later expansion matrix explicitly required concrete file checks, questions and stronger decision pressure.

The scene card explicitly says the exact external event form would be fixed later; the later expansion plan required the operations-yard report, operational confusion and injured guard to be concretely enacted.

The card still leaves the exact identifier/data kind as person/device/vehicle or comparable; the expansion matrix later fixes the existing limited license-plate comparison and requires its boundaries and logging to be concrete.

The card offers several alternative forms of harm to the wrongly burdened person and explicitly leaves the exact form open; the expansion matrix later requires concrete work/private consequences and Daniel experiencing them rather than only registering them intellectually.

The scene card is unusually complete on plot and knowledge state. The later expansion need is mainly to spend more scene time on the Weber trade-off, Daniel's counter-hypotheses for Lena and the real consequences of restricting her. A mechanical completeness check should not pretend to decide this.
The card requires false tracks to go nowhere but does not fix the concrete discarded hypotheses; the expansion matrix later makes rejection of false omission hypotheses a central enactment task.

The card leaves the second independent confirmation as time/place or preparation action; the expansion matrix later requires the independent anchors to be individually verified and weak pieces explicitly discarded.

The scene card is already highly concrete about goals, alternatives, access logic, physical options, information boundaries and Cold-Open facts. v0.1 would likely pass it, yet the later expansion matrix still required the last 30–60 seconds and aftermath to be played substantially longer. This is kept as a known limitation rather than tuning the gate to force a failure.
